objectives: Identify the shared sn onset in taught words.

concepts: The onset is the beginning consonant sound or blend.
The rime contains the vowel and following sounds.
Words can share an onset but have different rimes.
Word-family work requires decoding the complete word.

definitions.definition: The initial consonant sound or blend before the vowel.
The vowel and sounds that follow it.
